hypothesis: For each commodity including gold and silver, concentrate index-side weight on Nasdaq100 and news-side weight on reported outcomes before a fixed outer 50:50 blend. No claim of directly measuring public sentiment.
news_experts: B1+reported-outcome candidate clauses versus B1+remaining clauses; same keyword/direction features, clause counts
primary: Focused weights selected separately from [0.5,0.75,1]; fixed outer 0.5*index+0.5*news
control: Unconstrained weights selected separately from full grid
selection: Minimum 8 earlier out-of-fold predictions whose target ends before current origin; inner fit minimum 8 completed training samples; MAE selection; ties prefer 0.5; fallback 0.5
evaluation: Same origins as frozen ten-indicator experiment; fixed ridge lambda1 and training-only scaling; no outer outcomes used for weight choice
limitations: Post-hoc design on previously inspected data; no untouched holdout. Clauses are heuristic, not verified outcomes; news publication timing unverified. Descriptive block intervals not corrected for multiple comparisons. No current forecast.
